_meta.description: UK-specific series catalogue for the UK Macro Heatmap. Single source of truth for UK series identity, source, and ingestion metadata. 48 series covering Growth, Inflation, Employment, Wages, and Housing (assigned to Growth factor). Mirrors the schema of series_catalogue.json.

field_reference.id: Unique machine-readable slug. Used to cross-reference series across tools and config files.
field_reference.name: Human-readable short label.
field_reference.description: What the series measures and why it matters.
field_reference.source: Data vendor: bloomberg | haver | ecb | eurostat | derived.
field_reference.ticker_bloomberg: Bloomberg ticker string (e.g. 'PMITUKG Index'). null if not available on Bloomberg.
field_reference.ticker_haver: Haver mnemonic (e.g. 'PMIUKCO@EMERGE'). null if not available on Haver.
field_reference.units: Unit/scale of the raw series as pulled from source.
field_reference.typical_lag_days: Calendar days from reference period end to typical publication date. null for daily market data (no publication lag).
field_reference.asset_class: Grouping: macro_survey | macro_activity | macro_inflation | macro_labour | government_bonds | rates_swaps | inflation_swaps | commodities | volatility.
field_reference.geography: Primary geographic scope of the series.
field_reference.tools: List of tool IDs in the hub that consume this series.
field_reference.role: How the series is used: factor_input (DFM macro block) | target (y-variable in regression model) | predictor (x-variable) | market_data (general market series).
field_reference.dfm_factor: For factor_input series: which DFM factor this series primarily identifies (Growth | Inflation | Employment | Wages). Housing series are assigned Growth.
field_reference.dfm_sign: For factor_input series: +1 if series moves in the same direction as the factor, -1 if inverse (e.g. unemployment rate is -1 for Employment factor).
field_reference.dfm_col_index: Zero-based column index in the DFM observation matrix Y_daily. Must be contiguous 0-47.
field_reference.dfm_primary: True for exactly one series per factor group — the sign-anchor series used for PCA orientation.
field_reference.heatmap_group: Display grouping label used in the UK heatmap UI.
field_reference.notes: Free-text caveats, data quirks, or ingestion instructions.

series.name: UK Composite PMI
series.description: S&P Global/CIPS UK Composite PMI Output Index. Covers manufacturing and services. Above 50 = expansion. Flash estimate is the market-moving release.
series.notes: Use flash release date as ingestion date (~3 weeks after month-end). Final release follows ~1 week later but adds little information.

series.name: UK Services PMI
series.description: S&P Global/CIPS Services PMI Business Activity Index. Flash released ~3 weeks after month-end.

series.name: UK Manufacturing PMI
series.description: S&P Global/CIPS Manufacturing PMI Output Index.

series.name: UK Construction PMI
series.description: S&P Global/CIPS UK Construction PMI.
series.notes: May need separate Haver mnemonic from Composite PMI; verify on data delivery.

series.name: UK GDP (m/m)
series.description: ONS monthly GDP estimate, month-on-month % change.

series.name: UK GDP (3m/3m)
series.description: ONS GDP rolling 3-month vs prior 3 months % change.

series.name: UK Industrial Production (y/y)
series.description: ONS industrial production index, year-on-year % change. Covers manufacturing, mining, and energy.

series.name: UK Services Output (y/y)
series.description: ONS Index of Services year-on-year % change.

series.name: UK Retail Sales Volume (y/y)
series.description: ONS retail sales volume including fuel, year-on-year % change.

series.name: UK Retail Sales ex-Fuels (y/y)
series.description: ONS retail sales volume excluding automotive fuel, year-on-year % change.

series.name: BRC Retail Sales Monitor (y/y)
series.description: BRC-KPMG Retail Sales Monitor total retail value year-on-year % change.
series.notes: Not available on Haver; Bloomberg only.

series.name: CBI Industrial Trends (Output Balance)
series.description: CBI Industrial Trends Survey manufacturing output balance.

series.name: GfK Consumer Confidence
series.description: GfK/NatCen UK Consumer Confidence overall balance.

series.name: UK New Car Registrations (y/y)
series.description: SMMT new car registrations year-on-year % change.
series.notes: Not available on Haver; Bloomberg only.

series.name: UK Business Investment (y/y)
series.description: ONS gross fixed capital formation business investment, year-on-year % change.
series.notes: Quarterly frequency; released with National Accounts.

series.name: UK Services CPI (y/y)
series.description: ONS CPI services component year-on-year % change — primary BoE inflation watchpoint.
series.notes: Most closely watched BoE inflation sub-component; stickier than goods inflation.

series.name: UK Core CPI (y/y)
series.description: ONS CPI excluding food and energy, year-on-year % change.

series.name: UK CPI (y/y)
series.description: ONS headline CPI year-on-year % change.

series.name: UK CPIH (y/y)
series.description: ONS CPI including owner occupiers' housing costs, year-on-year % change.
series.notes: ONS preferred inflation measure since 2017.

series.name: UK RPI (y/y)
series.description: ONS Retail Prices Index year-on-year % change — used in index-linked Gilt coupon calculations.
series.notes: Key for index-linked Gilts; ONS no longer recommends RPI as a general inflation measure.

series.name: UK PPI Input (y/y)
series.description: ONS input prices to UK manufacturers year-on-year % change — leading indicator for consumer prices.

series.name: UK PPI Output (y/y)
series.description: ONS output prices of UK manufacturers year-on-year % change.

series.name: BRC Shop Price Index (y/y)
series.description: BRC Shop Price Index year-on-year % change — timely indicator of retail price inflation.
series.notes: Not available on Haver; Bloomberg only.

series.name: UK Import Prices (y/y)
series.description: ONS import price index year-on-year % change — pass-through from global prices and sterling.

series.name: UK Inflation Expectations (2y, Citi/YouGov)
series.description: Citi/YouGov survey 2-year ahead inflation expectations.
series.notes: Not available on Haver; Bloomberg only.

series.name: UK ILO Unemployment Rate
series.description: ONS Labour Force Survey ILO unemployment rate (3-month rolling) — primary employment indicator.
series.notes: Sign=-1: higher unemployment = weaker employment conditions.

series.name: UK Claimant Count Change
series.description: ONS/DWP claimant count monthly change (thousands) — timely flow indicator for labour market.
series.notes: Sign=-1: rising claimant count = deteriorating labour market.

series.name: UK Employment Change (3m/3m)
series.description: ONS LFS total employment change on prior 3 months (thousands).

series.name: UK Job Vacancies (3m average)
series.description: ONS Vacancy Survey 3-month average total vacancies (thousands).

series.name: UK Economic Inactivity Rate
series.description: ONS LFS economically inactive aged 16-64 as % of population — structurally elevated post-Covid.
series.notes: Sign=-1: higher inactivity = worse labour market conditions.

series.name: UK Payrolled Employees (m/m change)
series.description: HMRC PAYE payrolled employees month-on-month change (thousands) — more timely than LFS.

series.name: KPMG/REC Permanent Placements
series.description: KPMG/REC UK Report on Jobs: permanent staff placements index (>50 = growth).
series.notes: Not available on Haver; Bloomberg only.

series.name: KPMG/REC Staff Availability
series.description: KPMG/REC UK Report on Jobs: permanent candidate availability index — higher = more workers available = looser labour market.
series.notes: Sign=-1: higher staff availability = looser labour market = weaker Employment factor. Not available on Haver; Bloomberg only.

series.name: UK AWE Regular Pay (y/y)
series.description: ONS Average Weekly Earnings excluding bonuses year-on-year % change — primary BoE wage tracker (private sector component drives BoE modal).
series.notes: Most closely watched BoE wage gauge.

series.name: UK AWE Total Pay (y/y)
series.description: ONS Average Weekly Earnings including bonuses year-on-year % change.

series.name: UK AWE Private Sector Regular Pay (y/y)
series.description: ONS AWE private sector excluding bonuses year-on-year % change — most BoE-relevant wage gauge.

series.name: UK AWE Public Sector Regular Pay (y/y)
series.description: ONS AWE public sector excluding bonuses year-on-year % change — tracks negotiated pay settlements.

series.name: UK AWE Services Sector Pay (y/y)
series.description: ONS AWE services industries total pay year-on-year % change — dominant sector of UK economy.

series.name: KPMG/REC Starting Salaries Index
series.description: KPMG/REC UK Report on Jobs: permanent starting salaries index — leading wage indicator.
series.notes: Not available on Haver; Bloomberg only.

series.name: UK Unit Labour Costs (y/y)
series.description: ONS unit labour costs whole economy year-on-year % change — wages adjusted for productivity.
series.notes: Quarterly frequency; released with National Accounts productivity statistics.

series.name: RICS House Price Balance
series.description: RICS Residential Market Survey net balance of surveyors reporting price rises — leading housing indicator.
series.notes: Housing series assigned Growth factor per design rationale.

series.name: Halifax HPI (y/y)
series.description: Halifax House Price Index year-on-year % change — longest running UK house price series.
series.notes: Housing series assigned Growth factor per design rationale.

series.name: Nationwide HPI (y/y)
series.description: Nationwide House Price Index year-on-year % change.
series.notes: Housing series assigned Growth factor per design rationale.

series.name: UK Mortgage Approvals
series.description: BoE mortgage approvals for house purchase (thousands) — leading indicator of housing activity with ~3-6 month lead.
series.notes: Housing series assigned Growth factor per design rationale.

series.name: UK Property Transactions
series.description: HMRC UK residential property transactions (thousands) — realised housing demand.
series.notes: Housing series assigned Growth factor per design rationale.

series.name: UK Land Registry HPI (y/y)
series.description: ONS/HMLR UK House Price Index year-on-year % change — covers all transactions including cash buyers.
series.notes: Housing series assigned Growth factor per design rationale. Long lag (~90 days) due to registration delays.

series.name: UK Housebuilding Starts
series.description: MHCLG new-build dwelling starts England (thousands) — supply-side housing indicator.
series.notes: Housing series assigned Growth factor per design rationale. Quarterly frequency.

series.name: UK Mortgage Net Lending (m/m)
series.description: BoE net mortgage lending month-on-month change (GBP bn) — flow of new credit into housing.
series.notes: Housing series assigned Growth factor per design rationale.
